tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background. Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists and secondary buttons: one step off the background, no border.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected state on a surface, and selected chips.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: 1px hairline between list rows and sections. Never used as a box border.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headlines, amounts and body text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, subtitles and inactive tabs on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Exempt from contrast rules, so never use it for readable content.

tokens.name: fill-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Inverts between themes so it needs no brand colour.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on fill-primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, active tab, selected state, focus ring and the optional accent button. At most one accent-filled element per screen.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet accent wash behind a selected row or badge. Pair with accent text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains and success. Always shown with a + sign, never colour alone.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses and errors. Always shown with a - sign or message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind dialogs and menus. Black at 40% in light and 65% in dark; never a decorative overlay.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and accessibility focus ring, 2px, 2px offset.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The single most important number on a screen. One per screen.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Subtitles, metadata, tab labels and chart ranges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps and tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related elements, such as a label and its amount.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and screen edge margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections and horizontal button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large separation above a screen's main block.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Button height and minimum touch target.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, avatars and pills.
